doc_friction.issue: Step 0: security_next.py offered alert #1246 as workable, but another session had pushed its claim branch about 10 s earlier; --claim then reported 0 workable. That's the race the tool is meant to settle. It worked, but two scheduled sessions started together keep colliding on the same top alert.

acquisition.gov, ecfr.gov and dibnet.dod.mil are blocked (403/ENOTFOUND), but raw.githubusercontent.com/GSA/GSA-Acquisition-DFARS/master/dita/<clause>.dita serves the official DFARS text. Worth naming in cloud-session.md 'Outbound hosts' next to the FAR repo.

deviations.why: The no-endorsement guard /DoD-approved/ flagged the clause's own phrase 'DoD-approved medium assurance certificate'.
deviations.did: Added a negative lookahead for that exact phrase instead of rewording the clause's term.
deviations.result: The guard still catches every other use; tests pass.

notes: Explore idea: a DFARS 252.204-7012 cyber incident clock and checklist as a bet #4 (CMMC workspace) front door on machine-shop-guides. The clause was read in full from GSA's DFARS DITA source; 3 verbatim quotes are hash-pinned. Venture tests: node --test *.test.mjs 84 pass / 0 fail; incident tests also pass in two other time zones; Playwright smoke at 390 px: no errors, no overflow, XSS text rendered as text, nothing stored by default. Security alert #1246 (js/bad-tag-filter, ssp.test.mjs:123) was claimed by another session; the new test avoids that pattern (case-insensitive, escape-aware).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: read clause, write module+tests+page+sources+post, as a compliance-aware web dev

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
